history.1.5.0: Typed organizing facts and no-op safe transfer/storage policies (F4-B)
history.1.6.0: Typed metadata/coverage and cached source no-op policies (F4-C)
history.1.7.0: F4-D typed system/notification/settings/Telegram facts; pre-effect module declines and /hello ingress example
history.1.7.1: Two-phase pure offer/execute module protocol; only pre-execute declines can fall back
history.1.8.0: F4 bounded workflow and opt-in fake auth broker contracts; no real login provider
history.1.8.1: Declare hello action Host scopes; opt-in no-secret action ceiling probe
history.1.9.0: Bounded manual agent tools (no autonomous loop), readonly echo and own-KV write examples
